summary: This Form 6-K reports that on May 13, 2026, the company's Chairman, Mr. Choo Chee Kong, entered into a private share purchase agreement to acquire 112,000 ordinary shares from an independent arm's-length shareholder for cash. The company was not a party and received no proceeds. Mr. Choo intends to continue privately negotiating to increase his shareholding. No price, premium, or other deal terms are disclosed. This is an insider purchase, not a special situation event.
